clips.title: The story
paras: Marleth Barleybrew is an ambitious dwarven brewer stationed out in Brewnall Village. Frustrated by the Thunderbrew clan's dominance over the local beer market, she constantly schemes to prove her family's brew is superior to Kharanos's famous Thunder Ale.

In Dun Morogh, alcohol is taken as seriously as steel, and the rivalry between the Barleybrew and Thunderbrew families is legendary. Marleth Barleybrew resents the near-monopoly that Ragnar Thunderbrew and his kin maintain out of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Convinced her own craft is every bit as robust, she seeks clever ways to slip Barleybrew kegs into the hands of tavern patrons. Rather than engaging in open conflict, she opts for petty subterfuge, recruiting passing travelers to secretly swap out Kharanos's prized ale casks with her own.
